canDoYue: 你識講頭班機延遲、趕唔切接駁、改簽、行李轉駁、膳食代用券，同埋拎新登機證。
canDoEn: Say the first flight was delayed, you missed the connection, ask to rebook, confirm the checked bag will transfer, take a meal voucher, and collect a new boarding pass.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello, my first flight was badly delayed at the gate, and I have missed the next connection.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，頭班機喺閘口延遲得好厲害，我趕唔切下一程接駁。
dialogue.say: Hello, my first flight was badly delayed at the gate, and I have missed the next connection.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: I can see that delayed flight on the board, and the next connection leaves from another gate soon.
dialogue.glossYue: 我見到板上嗰班延遲，下一程接駁就快喺另一個閘口開。
dialogue.say: I can see that delayed flight on the board, and the next connection leaves from another gate soon.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you please rebook me on the next open flight, and will my checked bag transfer too?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以幫我改簽下一班，寄艙行李會唔會一齊轉？
dialogue.say: Can you please rebook me on the next open flight, and will my checked bag transfer too?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes, I can rebook you on that open flight, and the checked bag will transfer with you.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，我幫你改簽嗰班，寄艙行李會一齊轉。
dialogue.say: Yes, I can rebook you on that open flight, and the checked bag will transfer with you.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: May I please have a meal voucher while I wait, and where is the new departure gate?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以畀張膳食代用券，新閘口喺邊？
dialogue.say: May I please have a meal voucher while I wait, and where is the new departure gate?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes, this meal voucher covers a hot sandwich, and the new departure gate is posted on the board.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張膳食代用券可以換個熱三文治，新閘口喺板上。
dialogue.say: Yes, this meal voucher covers a hot sandwich, and the new departure gate is posted on the board.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please print a new boarding pass for me before I walk over to that posted departure gate.
dialogue.glossYue: 請喺我行去板上嗰個閘口之前，印張新登機證。
dialogue.say: Please print a new boarding pass for me before I walk over to that posted departure gate.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Your new boarding pass is printing at this desk, so please walk over to the posted gate.
dialogue.glossYue: 新登機證喺櫃檯印緊，請行去板上嗰個閘口。
dialogue.say: Your new boarding pass is printing at this desk, so please walk over to the posted gate.
